none: PAS NLM-7B6D19: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow. Diameter: 16.3mm, Weight: 1.56gms, die axis: 12
